data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: fix-bug shell-script fix emits "Antipattern-Scan: <query> root=<scan-root> matches=<n>" commit trailer from anti-pattern-scan.md SCAN_RESULT trailer_line, copied verbatim into the commit message.

(Shared with task-5c, which owns the verbatim-copy evidence in SKILL.md. This task owns the source-field half: the SCAN_RESULT schema must define the two new fields so the trailer payload exists for task-5c to copy.)

Extend the SCAN_RESULT output schema in plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/prompts/anti-pattern-scan.md with two new fields: `query_used` (the exact antipattern query/regex the scanner ran) and `trailer_line` (the rendered "Antipattern-Scan: <query> root=<scan-root> matches=<n>" string ready to copy verbatim into the commit message). Add both to the schema block, the Field Definitions table, and the rendering instructions so the scan sub-agent emits them deterministically. Instruction-file change only; no executable logic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] SCAN_RESULT schema block declares query_used — Verify: grep -A40 'SCAN_RESULT:' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/prompts/anti-pattern-scan.md | grep -q 'query_used'
- [ ] SCAN_RESULT schema block declares trailer_line — Verify: grep -A40 'SCAN_RESULT:' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/prompts/anti-pattern-scan.md | grep -q 'trailer_line'
- [ ] trailer_line rendering instruction shows the exact 'Antipattern-Scan: <query> root=<scan-root> matches=<n>' format — Verify: grep -qE 'Antipattern-Scan: <query> root=<scan-root> matches=<n>' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/prompts/anti-pattern-scan.md
- [ ] Field Definitions table documents both new fields — Verify: grep -c -E '\| .query_used.|\| .trailer_line.' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/prompts/anti-pattern-scan.md | awk '{exit ($1>=2)?0:1}'
- [ ] TDD exemption: unit criterion 1 — instruction-file (.md prompt) change with no executable logic; structural grep assertions on the schema block and field table are the behavioral verification. No RED unit test applies to a prompt-template edit.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Extend anti-pattern-scan.md SCAN_RESULT with query_used + trailer_line fields
